title: Network pharmacology and in vitro experimental verification to explore the mechanism of Sanhua decoction in the treatment of ischaemic stroke.
authors: Zhang, Wei; Zhang, Li; Wang, Wen Jun; Ma, Shanbo; Wang, Mingming; Yao, Minna; Li, Ruili; Li, Wei Wei; Zhao, Xian; Hu, Dongmei; Ding, Yi; Wang, Jingwen
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和体外实验研究三花汤治疗缺血性卒中的机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: CONTEXT: Stroke is an illness with high morbidity, disability and mortality that presents a major clinical challenge. Sanhua decoction (SHD) has been widely used to treat ischaemic stroke in the clinic. However, the potential mechanism of SHD remains unknown. OBJECTIVE: To elucidate the multitarget mechanism of SHD in ischaemic stroke through network pharmacology and bioinformatics analyses. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Network pharmacology and experimental validation approach was used to investigate the bioactive ingredients, critical targets and potential mechanisms of SHD against ischaemic stroke. Four herbal names of SHD, 'ischemic stroke' or 'stroke' was used as a keyword to search the relevant databases. SH-SY5Y cells were treated with various concentrations of SHD (12.5, 25, 50 or 100 mug/mL) for 4 h, exposed to oxygen and glucose deprivation (OGD) for 1 h, then reoxygenation for 24 h. The cell viability was detected by MTT, the lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) was evaluated by ELISA, and protein expression was detected by western blots. RESULTS: SHD treatment increased the survival rate from 65.9 +/- 4.3 to 85.56 +/- 5.7%. The median effective dose (ED(50)) was 47.1 mug/mL, the LDH decreased from 288.0 +/- 12.0 to 122.8 +/- 9.1 U/L and the cell apoptosis rate decreased from 33.6 +/- 1.8 to 16.3 +/- 1.2%. Western blot analysis revealed that SHD increased the levels of p-PI3k, p-Akt and p-CREB1, and decreased the expression of TNF-alpha and IL-6. DISCUSSION AND CONCLUSIONS: This study suggests that SHD protects against cerebral ischaemic injury via regulation of the PI3K/Akt/CREB1 and TNF pathways.
abstract_zh: 背景：脑卒中是一种高发病率、高致残率和高死亡率的疾病，构成重大临床挑战。三化汤（SHD）在临床上广泛用于治疗缺血性脑卒中。然而，SHD的潜在机制尚不清楚。目的：通过网络药理学和生物信息学分析，阐明SHD在缺血性脑卒中中的多靶点机制。材料与方法：采用网络药理学和实验验证方法，研究SHD抗缺血性脑卒中的生物活性成分、关键靶点和潜在机制。以SHD的四种草药名称及“缺血性脑卒中”或“脑卒中”为关键词，检索相关数据库。SH-SY5Y细胞分别用不同浓度SHD（12.5、25、50或100 μg/mL）处理4小时，暴露于氧糖剥夺（OGD）1小时，再复氧24小时。通过MTT检测细胞活力，通过ELISA评估乳酸脱氢酶（LDH），通过蛋白质印迹检测蛋白表达。结果：SHD处理将存活率从65.9 ± 4.3%提高至85.56 ± 5.7%。半数有效剂量（ED(50)）为47.1 μg/mL，LDH从288.0 ± 12.0降至122.8 ± 9.1 U/L，细胞凋亡率从33.6 ± 1.8%降至16.3 ± 1.2%。蛋白质印迹分析显示，SHD增加了p-PI3k、p-Akt和p-CREB1的水平，并降低了TNF-α和IL-6的表达。讨论与结论：本研究表明，SHD通过调节PI3K/Akt/CREB1和TNF通路，对脑缺血性损伤具有保护作用。
